name: M109A7 Paladin
note: BAE Systems M109A7 Paladin 155 mm self-propelled howitzer (155 mm/39-calibre M284 cannon). Crew of four. Firing range up to ~36 km with rocket-assisted projectiles (~24 km unassisted; ~40+ km with Excalibur precision rounds).

source.title: M109 howitzer | Wikipedia
source.note: 'firing range of up to 36 km' with assisted projectiles; ~24 km unassisted; Excalibur precision rounds reach ~40+ km.

name: CAESAR 155 mm
note: Nexter CAESAR 155 mm/52-calibre truck-mounted self-propelled howitzer. Crew of five (can be operated by fewer). Carries 18 rounds. Range ~42 km with extended-range base-bleed shells, up to ~55 km with V-LAP; the exact infobox range was not captured on fetch.
